title.en: Geography and Archaeological Findings of Indus Valley Civilisation
title.hi: Geography and Archaeological Findings of Indus Valley Civilisation

definition.en: An analytical study of the spatial distribution, physical boundaries, and material culture recovered from major Harappan sites.
definition.hi: An analytical study of the spatial distribution, physical boundaries, and material culture recovered from major Harappan sites.

importanceInUpsc.en: This microtopic is a high-yielding area for UPSC Prelims, frequently featuring map-based questions on site locations, river basins, and associated artifacts. Mains questions often evaluate how geographical factors and material evidence reflect urban planning, trade networks, and socioeconomic structures.
importanceInUpsc.hi: This microtopic is a high-yielding area for UPSC Prelims, frequently featuring map-based questions on site locations, river basins, and associated artifacts. Mains questions often evaluate how geographical factors and material evidence reflect urban planning, trade networks, and socioeconomic structures.

learningOutcomes.en: Map the geographical boundaries and major river basins of the Indus Valley Civilisation.
learningOutcomes.hi: Map the geographical boundaries and major river basins of the Indus Valley Civilisation.

learningOutcomes.en: Identify key archaeological sites including Harappa, Mohenjo-daro, and Dholavira along with their unique features.
learningOutcomes.hi: Identify key archaeological sites including Harappa, Mohenjo-daro, and Dholavira along with their unique features.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the significance of material culture such as seals, pottery, weights, and town-planning structures.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the significance of material culture such as seals, pottery, weights, and town-planning structures.
